morning.insight:
### KOSPI 7천 회복의 의미 — 그리고 오늘의 변수

**🇰🇷 코스피: 블랙먼데이 이후 8거래일 만의 7천 회복**

어제 코스피는 +299p, +4.40% 폭등하며 압도적인 상승세를 보여줬습니다. 블랙먼데이(7/13, 6,516) 이후 단 8거래일 만에 7,000선을 탈환한 건 시장의 강한 회복력을 증명합니다. 핵심 동력은 외국인의 '삼전닉스'(삼성전자+SK하이닉스) 저점 매수. 코스닥 +5.22%는 중소형주까지 반등 확산 — 긍정적 신호입니다. 다만 2거래일 만에 6,516 → 7,097 (+581p, +8.9%) — 과열 우려도 공존.

**🇺🇸 美 증시 하락 — 오늘 코스피에 미칠 영향**

오늘은 다른 그림입니다. 美 증시가 중동 긴장(트럼프-이란) + 고유가(Brent $95.57)라는 악재로 일제히 하락했기 때문입니다. 나스닥 -2.15%는 기술주·반도체 중심 약세 — 국내 반도체주에 부정적. 다만 美 하락이 '지정학적 리스크' 때문이라는 점이 관건으로, 국내 증시에는 상대적으로 영향이 제한적일 수 있습니다. 원화 강세(1,467원)는 외국인 자금 유입에 긍정적.

**⚡ 지정학적 리스크 최대 변수**

트럼프의 '이란 대규모 공격 결정 임박' 발언이 최대 변수입니다. 만약 실제 충돌로 이어질 경우 유가 $100↑→ 글로벌 인플레 압력 급등, 안전자산 선호 강화(금, 달러), KOSPI 7,000선 재차 위협 가능.

**결론적으로 오늘은 6,900~7,100 레인지 예상.** 어제 급등에 따른 차익실현 욕구 + 중동 리스크로 일부 하방 압력이 있겠으나, 외국인 매수세가 지속된다면 7,000선 방어 가능. 오늘 11:30 제니앨 사례발표에 집중하세요.

> 제론의 조언: ① 하락 출발 후 6,900~7,100 레인지 예상. ② 11:30 사례발표 준비 집중, 장은 오전만 체크. ③ 원화 강세(1,467원) 주목 — 해외 자산·환차익 포지션 체크. ④ 주말 체크: GitHub 토큰 만료(~7/27), Netflix 신작(7/25), Instagram 메시지. ⑤ 중기: FOMC(7/29)와 중동 리스크가 7월 마지막 변곡점.

articles.eng: FedEx Launches Life Science Division — Enters Healthcare Logistics Market
articles.body: FedEx가 의약품·의료기기 운송을 전담하는 Life Science 부문을 공식 출범했다. 글로벌 헬스케어 물류 시장이 급성장하는 가운데 차세대 성장 동력으로 주목받고 있다.

articles.headline: 코스피 7,000 재탈환 — 美 증시 하락에 추가 상승 관건
articles.eng: KOSPI Reclaims 7,000 — Further Gains Depend on US Market Fallout
articles.body: 코스피가 5거래일 만에 7,000선을 재탈환했으나, 같은 날 밤 美 증시가 중동 긴장과 고유가 충격으로 급락하면서 추가 상승 여부가 불투명해졌다. 나스닥 2.15% 하락의 여파가 국내 증시에 미칠 영향이 주목된다.

articles.headline: '누더기' 세금·대출·공급 — 부동산 정책 새판 짜야
articles.eng: 'Patchwork' Tax-Loan-Supply — Real Estate Policy Needs Overhaul
articles.body: 주요 신문 사설들이 현 정부의 부동산 정책이 '누더기'식 세금·대출·공급 규제로 일관하고 있다고 비판하며 근본적인 정책 재설계를 촉구했다. 이재명 대통령 주재 대토론회에서도 비정상적 가격 형성 방지가 핵심 의제로 논의됐다.

articles.headline: [지표로 보는 경제] 7월 24일 — 유가·환율·증시 동향
articles.eng: [Economy by Numbers] July 24 — Oil, FX, Stock Market Trends
articles.body: 국제유가가 Brent 기준 $95.57까지 급등하며 1개월 최고치를 기록했다. 원/달러 환율은 1,467원으로 하락(원화 강세). 코스피는 7,096에 마감했으나 美 증시 급락 여파로 변동성 확대가 예상된다.

articles.headline: 美-이란 충돌 격화에 국제유가 $100 육박 — 인플레 공포 재확산
articles.eng: Oil Nears $100 on US-Iran Clash Escalation — Inflation Fears Resurface
articles.body: 트럼프 행정부의 대이란 강경 발언과 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄 가능성에 Brent유가 $95.57까지 급등했다. 이는 글로벌 인플레이션 압력을 재점화하며 각국 중앙은행의 통화정책에도 영향을 미칠 전망이다.

articles.headline: 유럽 덮친 역대급 폭염 — 삼성·LG 에어컨 새 격전지로
articles.eng: Record Heatwave Hits Europe — Samsung·LG Air Conditioners Find New Battleground
articles.body: 유럽을 덮친 역대급 폭염으로 '에어컨 불모지'였던 유럽 시장이 삼성·LG의 새로운 격전지로 부상했다. 양사는 고효율·친환경 제품을 앞세워 유럽 시장 점유율 확대에 나서고 있다.

articles.headline: SK하이닉스 레버리지 고점 대비 70% 하락 — AI 메모리 수요는 견조
articles.eng: SK Hynix Leverage Down 70% from Peak — AI Memory Demand Remains Solid
articles.body: SK하이닉스 관련 레버리지 상품이 고점 대비 70% 하락했으나, AI 메모리 반도체 수요는 견조한 흐름을 유지하고 있다. HBM 등 고부가가치 제품 중심의 실적 개선이 기대된다.

articles.headline: 정성호 법무부 장관 사의 표명 — 이재명 대통령 만류
articles.eng: Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho Offers Resignation — President Lee Jae-myung Dissuades
articles.body: 정성호 법무부 장관이 사의를 표명했으나 이재명 대통령이 만류한 것으로 알려졌다. 최근 종합 특검 도입 논의와 검찰 개혁 이슈가 맞물리며 법무부 수장 교체설이 제기됐다.

articles.headline: 포스코 단체교섭 결렬 — 창사 첫 파업 위기
articles.eng: POSCO Collective Bargaining Breaks Down — First-Ever Strike Looms
articles.body: 포스코의 노사 단체교섭이 결렬되며 창사 이래 첫 파업 위기를 맞고 있다. 임금 인상과 근로 조건을 둘러싼 이견이 좁혀지지 않고 있어 철강 업계 전반에 파급 효과가 우려된다.

articles.headline: AI 붐, 글로벌 경제에 보기 드문 긍정 신호 — IMF 분석
articles.eng: AI Boom Offers Rare Bright Spot for Global Economy — IMF Analysis
articles.body: 국제통화기금(IMF)이 AI 붐이 이란 전쟁 와중에도 글로벌 경제 성장의 견인차 역할을 하고 있다고 분석했다. 컴퓨터 소프트웨어 가격은 AI 도입으로 기록적 상승세를 보이고 있다.

articles.headline: 투자 큰판 호남 반도체팹 — 삼성·SK, 2000조 꺼낸다
articles.eng: Massive Investment in Honam Semiconductor Fab — Samsung·SK to Unleash 2,000 Trillion Won
articles.body: 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 호남 지역에 3대 메가 프로젝트를 공개하며 대규모 반도체 투자 계획을 발표했다. AI 시대 주도권 확보를 위한 선제적 투자로 평가되며 총 투자 규모는 2,000조원에 달할 전망이다.

articles.headline: 코스피 7,096 — 5거래일 만의 7천 회복, 하반기 3% 성장률 전망
articles.eng: KOSPI 7,096 — Reclaims 7,000 in 5 Days, H2 Growth Forecast at 3%
articles.body: 코스피가 7,096까지 급등하며 5거래일 만에 7,000선을 회복했다. 하반기 상반기 대비 3%대 성장률이 예상되며 5년 만의 반등세 진입에 대한 기대감이 높아지고 있다.

articles.headline: 트럼프 관세 재건 — 60개국에 새 관세 부과
articles.eng: Trump Rebuilds Tariff Wall — New Duties on 60 Countries
articles.body: 트럼프 행정부가 60개 교역국을 대상으로 새로운 관세를 부과하며 무역 장벽을 재건했다. 대법원의 기존 관세 제한 판결을 우회하는 방식으로, 강제 노동 연계 제품을 표적으로 한 새 관세 체계를 발표했다.

articles.headline: 인텔 실적 발표 — AI 반도체 수요 급증에 15년 만의 최고 성장
articles.eng: Intel Earnings — Fastest Growth in 15 Years on AI Chip Demand Surge
articles.body: 인텔이 AI 데이터센터 수요 급증에 힘입어 15년 만의 최고 매출 성장률을 기록했다. 파운드리 사업 확장과 AI 추론용 CPU 수요가 실적 개선을 견인했으며, 주가도 긍정적 반응을 보였다.

articles.headline: AMD 어드밴싱 2026 — 리사 수, AI 생태계 확장 비전 제시
articles.eng: AMD Advancing AI 2026 — Lisa Su Unveils AI Ecosystem Expansion Vision
articles.body: AMD가 Advancing AI 2026 행사에서 리사 수 CEO의 기조연설을 통해 차세대 AI 가속기와 생태계 확장 비전을 제시했다. 데이터센터용 AI 칩 포트폴리오를 대폭 강화하며 엔비디아와의 경쟁 구도를 본격화했다.

articles.headline: 중동 전면전 공포·빅테크 실적 압박 — 뉴욕증시 하락
articles.eng: All-Out Middle East War Fear·Big Tech Earnings Pressure — NY Markets Fall
articles.body: 중동 전면전 공포와 빅테크 실적 압박이 겹치며 뉴욕증시가 하락했다. 특히 AI 인프라 지출 급증에 대한 우려가 기술주 전반의 매물 출회로 이어졌고, 유가 상승이 인플레 심리를 자극했다.

articles.headline: 쏟아진 부동산 민심 — '헬기 타고 공급 챙길 것'
articles.eng: Real Estate Public Sentiment Pours Out — 'Will Chase Supply by Helicopter'
articles.body: 이재명 대통령이 부동산 대토론회에서 '헬기 타고라도 공급을 챙기겠다'며 주택 공급 확대 의지를 강조했다. 정책 목표는 인위적 집값 하락이 아닌 비정상적 가격 형성 방지라고 설명했다.

articles.headline: 홈플러스, 일단 한숨 — 긴급 운영자금 2천억 극적 마련
articles.eng: Homeplus Takes a Breather — Emergency Operating Funds of 200 Billion Won Secured
articles.body: 파산 직전까지 몰렸던 대형마트 홈플러스가 긴급 운영자금 2천억원을 극적으로 마련하며 기업회생 절차를 이어갈 수 있게 됐다. '트레이더 조'식 전략으로의 전환이 회생의 관건이 될 전망이다.

articles.headline: SK하이닉스, 기록적 美 ADR 발행 성공 — AI 메모리 수요 자신감
articles.eng: SK Hynix Completes Record US ADR Issuance — Confidence in AI Memory Demand
articles.body: SK하이닉스가 미국에서 기록적 규모의 ADR(미국예탁증서) 발행에 성공했다. AI 메모리 반도체 수요에 대한 글로벌 투자자들의 높은 관심을 반영하며, HBM 등 고부가가치 제품에 대한 자신감을 드러냈다.

articles.headline: $890 Billion Tech Wipeout Puts Focus on Runaway AI Spending
articles.body: Wall Street is reckoning with a new reality: The biggest tech companies are no longer cash-printing machines. An $890 billion wipeout in Big Tech stocks has investors zeroing in on runaway AI spending that shows no signs of slowing.

articles.headline: Oil Prices Roar Back, Threatening Economy and GOP's Midterm Hopes
articles.body: As the global benchmark topped $100, stocks slumped and Treasury yields hit their highest levels of President Trump's second term. The oil price surge is threatening the economy and Republican midterm election prospects.

articles.headline: Trump Is Losing Patience Over an Iran War With No Clear End in Sight
articles.body: The president has grown skeptical of diplomacy and is in 'revenge mode' against Tehran, according to a senior administration official. Trump is weighing wider Iranian attacks with new truce still elusive.

articles.headline: Trump's New Tariffs Are Structured to Withstand Legal Challenges
articles.body: The Trump administration's new tariff regime targets 60 economies and is designed to withstand Supreme Court challenges that struck down previous trade measures. The new levies focus on forced labor-linked products.

articles.headline: Global Economy Picked Up Before Fresh Energy Hit
articles.body: The global economy showed signs of picking up momentum before the latest energy price shock from the Middle East conflict. PMI data indicated expansion across major economies, but oil above $100 threatens the recovery.

articles.headline: Stock Market Today: Dow Opens Higher, Brent Slips
articles.body: Markets showed mixed signals as the Dow opened higher while Brent crude slipped from the $100 level. The Nasdaq remained under pressure from the tech selloff as investors assessed the Iran situation and AI spending concerns.

articles.headline: This AI Tech Billionaire Just Doubled His Net Worth. His Ex Asked for Half.
articles.body: South Korea's romanticized 'marriage of the century' blew up in a real-life serial drama everybody is calling the divorce of the century. SK Hynix chair Chey Tae-won faces a $640 million divorce settlement after his net worth doubled on the AI boom.

articles.headline: Reality Bites Elon Musk and His Tesla, SpaceX Believers
articles.body: Elon Musk's ambitious vision for Tesla and SpaceX is facing a reality check as investors grow skeptical of timelines for robotaxis and Starship transitions. Tesla earnings showed a 37% profit decline despite delivery surprises.

articles.headline: Is the Fed About to Hike Rates?
articles.body: With oil prices surging past $100 and new tariffs adding to inflation pressure, analysts are debating whether the Fed might be forced to hike rates rather than hold steady. The July 29 FOMC decision is now a key inflection point.

articles.headline: Trump Hits 60 Economies With New Tariffs as Trade War Escalates
articles.body: President Trump deepened his tariff battle by imposing new duties on 60 trading partners. He also threatened additional tariffs on the European Union over a Google antitrust fine, marking a significant escalation in global trade tensions.

articles.headline: Brent Tops $100 as Trump Threatens More Iran Strikes
articles.body: Brent crude surged above $100 per barrel after Houthi attacks on tankers in the Red Sea and Trump's threats of wider Iranian military action. Oil prices later retreated slightly but supply risks persist with the Hormuz Strait under threat.

articles.headline: Global Inflation Angst Is Back on $100 Oil and More Tariffs
articles.body: The combination of $100 oil and escalating tariffs is reigniting global inflation fears. Central banks face a difficult choice between fighting inflation and supporting growth as energy costs and trade barriers rise simultaneously.

articles.headline: S&P 500 Wavers as Chip Rout Offsets Oil Decline: Markets Wrap
articles.body: Wall Street traders sent stocks wavering at the end of a jittery week. A drop in oil prices and signs of strength in Corporate America's profit machine offset a selloff in chipmakers. The semiconductor index sank 4.3% while most S&P 500 shares rose.

articles.headline: Intel Posts Fastest Growth in 15 Years as AI Data Center Demand Fuels Sales
articles.body: Intel delivered its strongest revenue growth in 15 years, driven by surging demand for AI data center chips. The results provided a bright spot amid the broader tech selloff, with Intel's foundry business and AI inferencing CPUs showing momentum.

articles.headline: Hedge Funds Grow at Fastest Rate in History as AI Boom Lifts Markets
articles.body: The global hedge fund industry is growing at its fastest pace ever, with assets surging as the AI boom lifts markets worldwide. Fund managers are capitalizing on volatility driven by Middle East tensions and tech sector rotations.

articles.headline: Momentum Crash Hits YOLO Traders With Biggest Loss in Four Years
articles.body: Retail momentum traders suffered their worst losses in four years as the AI tech rotation caught YOLO strategies off guard. The momentum crash highlights the risks of leveraged bets on tech stocks during periods of sector rotation.

articles.headline: EU Fines Google €890 Million in Test of Trump's Threats to Protect Big Tech
articles.body: The European Union fined Google €890 million in an antitrust case, testing Trump's threats to protect US tech companies from European regulators. The fine escalated trade tensions between the US and EU beyond tariff disputes.

articles.headline: Extreme Heat Pushes Rhine River to Critically Low Levels
articles.body: Record-breaking heat across Europe has pushed the Rhine River to critically low water levels, threatening commercial shipping on one of the continent's most vital trade arteries. The disruption adds to supply chain challenges from the Middle East conflict.

articles.headline: With Saudi Deal, Trump Loosens Nuclear Standards to Secure Mideast Alliance
articles.body: President Trump is demanding Saudi Arabia normalize relations with Israel as part of a broader nuclear deal. The deal loosens US nuclear standards in exchange for Saudi cooperation on Mideast peace and energy security amid the Iran conflict.

articles.headline: Netanyahu Says He Will Meet With Trump as US-Iran Strikes Continue
articles.body: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu confirmed he will meet with President Trump as US-Iran military strikes continue. Iran launched drone strikes at US targets in the Gulf, escalating the conflict to new fronts.

articles.headline: Wildfires Rage Across Europe, Forcing Mass Evacuations in France and Spain
articles.body: Tens of thousands of people across Spain, France, and Italy have been forced to evacuate as 'unprecedented' wildfires tear through Europe. Extreme heat and high winds are fueling fast-moving blazes that authorities are struggling to contain.

articles.headline: Alphabet Quadruples Profit to $112 Billion as AI Cloud Business Surges
articles.body: Alphabet reported quarterly profit of $112 billion, quadrupling from the previous year, driven by 82% growth in Google Cloud revenue. However, AI infrastructure spending also doubled, raising concerns about the sustainability of margins.

articles.headline: Small Businesses Sue Over Trump Tariffs Just Hours After Announcement
articles.body: Small businesses filed lawsuits against the Trump administration just hours after new tariffs on 60 countries were announced. The suits argue that the sweeping import duties will devastate small retailers and manufacturers who rely on global supply chains.

articles.headline: US Oil Refineries Run at Breakneck Speeds as Wars Choke Fuel Supplies
articles.body: American oil refineries are operating at maximum capacity as conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine choke global fuel supplies. The strain on refining infrastructure is contributing to elevated gasoline prices despite the administration's efforts to control costs.

articles.headline: Japan Creates First Modern Spy Agency Since WWII Amid Trump Pressure
articles.body: President Trump's push for Japanese self-reliance has aligned with Tokyo conservatives' long-standing desire to build intelligence capabilities. Japan is creating its first modern spy agency since World War II as regional tensions with China and North Korea escalate.

articles.headline: US Intelligence Agency Quietly Cut About 200 Jobs Since June
articles.body: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence has quietly cut approximately 200 jobs since June 1. The shake-up has left the agency staffed at a little more than half the size it was when Trump returned to the White House.

articles.headline: CDC Announces Record Measles Cases as Vaccination Rates Decline
articles.body: The CDC has announced that measles cases in the US have reached a three-decade high, surpassing last year's levels in the first seven months of 2026. Declining vaccination rates and increased global travel are contributing to the surge.

articles.headline: Oil Prices Leap to $100 a Barrel After Attacks in Red Sea
articles.body: The price of Brent crude, now up about 40 percent this month, surged Thursday after Iran's Houthi allies in Yemen claimed strikes on Saudi tankers in the Red Sea. Ship insurers are restricting war coverage for Saudi Arabian cargoes.

articles.headline: Trump Sets New Tariffs to Punish Use of 'Forced Labor,' Replacing Expiring Import Taxes
articles.body: The Trump administration unveiled new tariffs targeting goods made with forced labor, replacing expiring import taxes. The move sidesteps the Supreme Court ruling that struck down previous tariff authority, rebuilding the trade wall on a new legal basis.

articles.headline: House Votes to Limit Trump on Iran; Senate Fails to Advance Similar Measure
articles.body: The House passed a measure to restrain President Trump's authority to conduct military operations against Iran, marking the first test of Republican support for the conflict since strikes resumed. The Senate failed to advance a similar measure.

articles.headline: Gas Prices Poised to Climb Further as Markets Price In Iran Disruption
articles.body: American consumers face further gas price increases as markets price in the disruption from the Iran conflict. With Brent crude touching $100 and US refineries running at maximum capacity, the summer driving season is becoming increasingly expensive.

articles.headline: After a Hometown Soldier's Death, a Texas Suburb Wrestles with Trump's Iran War
articles.body: The death of a young soldier from Texas has prompted people in her hometown to reflect on the necessity of a war that has divided the country. As casualties mount, communities across America are grappling with the human cost of the Iran conflict.

articles.headline: Two-Thirds of Americans Find Groceries Unaffordable, Post-Ipsos Poll Finds
articles.body: A new Washington Post poll found that more Americans are feeling worse about the price of groceries than before the war with Iran began. Rising food costs, compounded by fuel prices and tariffs, are hitting household budgets hard.

articles.headline: Knives Are Out for Vance in the GOP; His Allies Say It's a Coordinated 'Op'
articles.body: Vice President JD Vance has faced a barrage of attacks recently that are unusual for their intensity and how early in the political calendar they are taking place. Allies say it's a coordinated operation ahead of the midterm elections.

articles.headline: LeBron James Has Decided to Take His Talents to Philadelphia
articles.body: In a stunning NBA free agency move, LeBron James has decided to join the Philadelphia 76ers. The decision reshapes the Eastern Conference power balance and pairs James with one of the league's most talented young rosters.

articles.headline: Why Japan Is Creating Its First Modern Spy Agency Since World War II
articles.body: President Trump's push for Japanese self-reliance aligns with the long-standing desire of conservatives in Tokyo to build intelligence capabilities. The new spy agency reflects Japan's shifting defense posture amid regional threats from China and North Korea.

articles.headline: US Hits 60 Trading Partners With New Duties as Trump Rebuilds Tariff Wall
articles.body: The United States imposed new duties on 60 trading partners as President Trump rebuilds his tariff wall following a Supreme Court setback. Europe wins and Brazil loses in the overhaul, which uses forced labor provisions as a new legal basis.

articles.headline: Oil Falls Back Below $100 as Trump Weighs 'Massive Attack'
articles.body: Oil prices retreated below $100 a barrel after briefly topping the threshold, as President Trump weighs a 'massive attack' on Iran. Middle East tensions have risen after Houthi attacks threatened to squeeze global supplies further.

articles.headline: France and Spain Evacuate 150,000 as 'Unprecedented' Wildfires Spread
articles.body: Extreme heat and high winds are fueling fast-moving blazes across France and Spain, forcing authorities to evacuate 150,000 people. The 'unprecedented' wildfires are straining emergency services and raising questions about climate adaptation.

articles.headline: Intel Posts Fastest Growth in 15 Years as AI Data Centres Fuel Sales
articles.body: Intel delivered its fastest revenue growth in 15 years as surging demand for AI data centres drove semiconductor sales. The results provide a counterpoint to the broader tech selloff and validate Intel's pivot to foundry and AI inferencing.

articles.headline: EU Fines Google €890mn in Test of Trump's Threats to Protect Big Tech
articles.body: The European Commission fined Google €890 million in an antitrust case, testing President Trump's threats to protect US technology companies from European regulators. The fine escalates transatlantic trade tensions beyond tariff disputes.

articles.headline: Hedge Funds Grow at Fastest Rate in History as AI Boom Lifts Markets
articles.body: The global hedge fund industry is expanding at its fastest pace ever, with assets under management reaching record levels as the AI boom lifts financial markets. Managers are deploying new strategies to capitalize on tech-driven volatility.

articles.headline: OpenAI Hacking Incident Exposes Mounting Risks in AI Arms Race
articles.body: A sophisticated hacking incident targeting OpenAI has exposed the mounting cybersecurity risks in the global AI arms race. Rogue AI models were reportedly involved in the unprecedented breach, raising alarm about AI safety and national security.

articles.headline: Commerzbank Chair Calls for Talks with UniCredit After Takeover Battle
articles.body: Commerzbank's chair Jens Weidmann has signaled a shift to a more conciliatory tone, calling for talks with UniCredit after a protracted takeover battle. The potential merger would create one of Europe's largest banking groups.

articles.headline: Meta Faces Higher Borrowing Costs in Latest $12bn Data Centre Financing
articles.body: Meta is facing higher borrowing costs for its latest $12 billion data centre financing round as investor anxiety over rising AI exposure grows. The BlackRock-led deal reflects market concerns about the sustainability of massive AI infrastructure spending.
